outcome: duration of labor (CRB insertion to delivery)
cohort: The study included 90 singleton nulliparous pregnancies undergoing mechanical induction of labor (IOL).
finding: Ultrasound-guided CRB placement was more effective in inducing cervical ripening and resulted in a significantly shorter duration of labor compared to speculum-guided placement.
mod_finding: No significant differences were found in the incidence of cesarean section between the two groups.
